title: 第十五章 新技能
novel_title: 魔头别夺舍了，我们正道快没人了
content_zh:
冲出山洞，季南北停下脚步，回身望向洞口方向。

    “吼!!“

    那头黑熊咆哮着猛冲而出，直扑季南北而来，粗壮的熊掌高高扬起。

    只能说这妖兽不愧拥有筑基期的修为，体型大得令人咋舌。

    之前在洞中蜷伏时，季南北还不易估量，此刻才看清，那黑熊直立起来竟有四五米之高!

    一只熊掌都比苏千雪这只小狐狸整个身子还大!

    一掌拍落，气势骇人。

    凭借疾行符带来的迅捷速度，季南北在千钧一发之际闪开了这一击。熊掌砸在地面上，发出震耳欲聋的轰响。

    只见季南北原先站立之处，土石进溅，竟被那黑熊砸出一个浅坑。

    要知道，那里原本可是一块坚硬的岩石。

    这一击的力道可想而知。

    而季南北在躲闪之后，立刻催动所剩不多的灵力，双爪并拢。

    那黑熊一击落空，转身再度向季南北扑来。

    双掌高举，意图将季南北直接拍成肉酱。

    就在此时，灵气引动，先前贴在黑熊背上的那张灵符，化作点点光尘，消散开来。

    那正是季南北不久前获得的三品灵符引雷符!天空中一声霹雳炸响。

    紧接着便是一道震耳欲聋的轰鸣，一道半径约有两三米的粗壮雷电骤然劈落。

    “轰隆!”

    那黑熊正举着双臂，宛如天然的引雷针，恰好接引了这道天雷。

    刹那间，雷电贯体，黑熊连惨嚎都未能发出，便陡然僵直。

    雷光散去，那庞大的身躯直挺挺地倒下，重重摔落在地，发出一声闷响。

    【讨伐完成，获得五万魔道点数，三品灵物“合欢散”已存入系统空间。]

    季南北无言以对。

    最终还是选了一次选项二，得到的自然也不是什么正经玩意儿。

    合欢散，这名字听着就不对劲，季南北连系统说明都懒得去看!

    确认黑熊已无生机后，季南北才缓步走到它跟前。

    近距离一看，黑熊身上的毛发都已焦糊。

    三品符篆，尤其是引雷符这种牵引天地之威的强大符篆，显然不是区区筑基期妖兽能够抵挡的。

    “哇，前辈你好厉害!”

    即使看不见苏千雪，季南北也能想象出这只小狐狸双眼发亮的模样。

    “近期你就待在此处，不要胡乱走动。这只黑熊残留的气息足够保你平安一阵子了，明白吗?”

    “嗯嗯嗯!”
content_en:
After rushing out of the cave, Ji Nanbei stopped and turned around to look in the direction of the cave entrance.

    "Roar!!"

    The black bear roared and rushed out, heading straight towards Ji Nan, its thick bear paws raised high.

    It can only be said that this monster deserves to have the cultivation level of the Foundation Establishment Stage, and its size is staggering.

    When Ji Nanbei was crouching in the cave before, it was not easy to estimate, but now he could see clearly that the black bear was four to five meters high when it stood upright!

    A bear's paw is bigger than the whole body of Su Qianxue, the little fox!

    Slap it down with a palm, the momentum is terrifying.

    Relying on the rapid speed brought by the speed talisman, Ji Nanbei dodged the attack at the critical moment. The bear's paw hit the ground with a deafening roar.

    I saw that where Ji Nanbei was standing, earth and rocks splashed in, and the black bear made a shallow pit.

    You know, it was originally a solid rock.

    The force of this blow can be imagined.

    After Ji Nanbei dodged, he immediately activated his remaining spiritual power and closed his claws together.

    The black bear's attack missed and turned around to charge at Ji Nanbei again.

    He raised his palms high, intending to beat Ji Nanbei into a pulp.

    At this moment, the spiritual energy was activated, and the spiritual talisman previously attached to the black bear's back turned into specks of light dust and dissipated.

    That was the third-grade spiritual talisman, the Thunder-Drawing Talisman, that Ji Nanbei obtained not long ago! A thunderbolt exploded in the sky.

    Then there was a deafening roar, and a thick thunder and lightning with a radius of about two or three meters suddenly struck down.

    "Boom!"

    The black bear was raising its arms, like a natural lightning rod, which happened to attract the thunder.

    In an instant, thunder and lightning struck the body, and the black bear suddenly became stiff even before it could even howl.

    The thunder light dissipated, and the huge body fell straight down, falling heavily to the ground with a muffled sound.

    [The crusade is completed, 50,000 magic points are obtained, and the third-grade spiritual object "Hehuan Powder" has been stored in the system space. ]

    Ji Nanbei was speechless.

    In the end, I chose option two, and what I got was naturally not a serious thing.

    Hehuansan, this name sounds wrong, Ji Nanbei didn't even bother to read the system description!

    After confirming that the black bear was lifeless, Ji Nanbei slowly walked up to it.

    A closer look shows that the hair on the black bear's body is burnt.

    Third-grade talisman seals, especially powerful talisman seals that attract the power of heaven and earth, such as the thunder talisman, are obviously not something that mere foundation-building monsters can withstand.

    "Wow, senior, you are so awesome!"

    Even if he couldn't see Su Qianxue, Ji Nanbei could still imagine the little fox's eyes shining brightly.

    "You stay here in the near future and don't move around randomly. The remaining breath of this black bear is enough to keep you safe for a while, do you understand?"

    "Uh huh huh!"
